verb: antler charge, rear-up stomp, rear kick; flees once, then turns territorial
look: giant Irish elk: stag with enormous palmate antlers (span ~6 m in game), dark brown back, cream neck ruff, tan legs; antlerless doe in tan with a grey-brown cape and cream throat
texture_prompt: stag: brown back, cream ruff, bone antlers with dark bases; doe: tan coat, grey-brown cape, cream throat

clips.attack_primary: stag: antler hook, head drops then rips up and sideways through the target (hit 0.42); doe: forehoof strike
clips.attack_heavy: rear-up stomp: rises ~40 deg on the hocks, forelegs folded and pawing (the tell), crashes forward, both forehooves slam down (hit 0.72)
clips.kick: rear kick: weight onto the forelegs, both hind hooves fire straight back and up (hit 0.45)
clips.charge: stag only: gallop with the head down and the antlers forward like a ram
clips.alert: stag: rut roar, then antlers lowered at the threat and shaken (charge telegraph); doe: head high, two warning stamps
clips.knockdown: forelegs buckle, rolls onto the right side
clips.death: forelegs buckle, rolls onto the right side, head down
clips.sleep: kneels in front first, then lies sternal with the legs folded
clips.feed: head down to graze, crops and chews

pipeline.size_note: ASSUMPTION: stag withers 3.36 m (a big Irish elk's ~2.1 m x the 1.6 house exaggeration, claude-raptorscale.md); doe ~15 % smaller (2.85 m withers). Both GLBs are built in game metres (scale 1). real_length_m 6.0 = the roster's 2x of ~3 m, keeps the small taming pen.
pipeline.reference: owner sheets megaloceros_owner_sheet_stag.png / _doe.png; stag views: Codex, antlers removed (ref/stag_tripo_*.png); doe views cropped from her sheet (ref/doe_tripo_*.png)
pipeline.build: tools/gait/megaloceros/build.sh (build_rig.py: deer skeleton with carpus/hock/fetlock, Jaw, geometric weights, Blender-built palmate antlers skinned to Head; clips.py: every clip authored on that rig)
pipeline.disabled_clips_note: MEGARUN (owner 2026-10-31: 'megaloceros doe strafe left animation is cursed... strafe right too'): CreatureAnim builds no strafe states, so a sideways step plays the forward walk. The joust brain never strafes; the GLBs stay for the clip viewer.

doe.natural_speeds_note: MEGARUN: her run strides 0.85x the stag's (tools/gait/megaloceros/clips.py DOE_STRIDE), and the game draws her GLB 1.069x (fitted to height_meters), so 0.85 x 1.069 x anim_events natural_speeds.megaloceros.run (9.406 -> 8.539; t_megarun checks it). Her walk is in stag metres, so only the 1.069: 2.295 -> 2.452. Rebake both together.

tactics._about: ASSUMPTION: the doe has no antlers, so no ram: she runs in to a forehoof strike (a homing charge into attack_primary) and at point blank rears up and stomps or kicks.

pipeline.variant_note: ASSUMPTION: sex is picked per animal by CreatureView.pick_variant (deterministic from the spawn spot, ~50/50). Both share one bone layout; the doe has her own mesh and clip folder.
